hotspots.title: Trump Rally Protests Ignite Fury
hotspots.blurb: A wave of protests at Donald Trump's recent rallies in Greenville, Kansas, and Wichita has sparked heated confrontations, with reporters being warned and demonstrators repeatedly removed. The clashes are framed as a battle between MAGA supporters and anti‑Trump activists.
hotspots.affect: The vivid scenes of protesters being ejected and the president’s angry exchanges fuel outrage and a sense of cultural war.

hotspots.title: JD Vance Endorsement Drama
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance’s campaign trail has become a flashpoint, with Trump refusing to endorse him, Vance’s own statements about a possible Trump backing, and heated criticism from media figures. The intra‑party feud is portrayed as a showdown over the future of the Republican ticket.
hotspots.affect: The back‑and‑forth over endorsement taps into rivalry and loyalty anxieties within the GOP base.

hotspots.title: Immigration Crackdown & Antisemitic Slur Fallout
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s renewed immigration enforcement, highlighted by a controversial antisemitic slur at a Wichita rally and Catholic criticism of ICE tactics, has sparked condemnation from Jewish groups and faith leaders, turning immigration into a moral‑panic narrative.
hotspots.affect: The combination of religious condemnation and xenophobic policy framing amplifies moral outrage and fear.

hotspots.title: Farm Relief & $5,000 Bonus Promises
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s $8 billion farm relief package and promises of $5,000 bonuses for voters if Republicans win dominate coverage, with farm groups both welcoming aid and demanding more. The narrative is cast as a lifeline for rural America versus government overreach.
hotspots.affect: The high‑stakes financial incentives and rural voting appeals generate strong emotional investment among agricultural constituencies.

hotspots.title: Election Intervention Lawsuits Surge
hotspots.blurb: A spate of legal actions—Trump’s lawsuit against California over ballot handling, the 100th California AG suit, and a raid using a list of 20,000 suspected non‑citizens—has been portrayed as an aggressive push to shape the 2026 midterms.
hotspots.affect: The depiction of judicial battles as a fight over democratic legitimacy fuels alarm and partisan outrage.
